access.service: ECMWF TIGGE (The THORPEX Interactive Grand Global Ensemble)
access.reason: ECMWF MARS API key (.ecmwfapirc) not found in system. Registration at ECMWF Data Services is required to fetch real-time or historical Day 8-10 TIGGE raw GRIB fields.
access.fallback_policy: Core Day 1-7 training system operates on verified WeatherGPT D1 (Open-Meteo NWP + ERA5-Land). Day 8-10 predictions return 'data_unavailable_for_training' until TIGGE archive is ingested. No fake or interpolated data will be generated.
